Diagnostics only; contextual stages already public. Signed residuals and flags to be reported regardless of magnitude.
selection.new_culvert: Konkapot River at Main Road, Monterey, Massachusetts. June 2020 public project report, Conceptual Design Alternative 1, 15-ft clear span and 10-ft clear height above streambed. Published Q100 is 1,620 cfs. Reconstruct only a local conditional screening subreach from source sections or from terrain with explicit assumptions. Published modeled stages are not measured validation. Existing dam and footbridge, any unverified submerged sections or terrain differences limit transfer. Keep published figures distinct from field data. Redirect unsupported existing arch geometry if reliable support is absent.
